slides.title: Welcome to Twinskaraoke
slides.body: Neuro and Evil karaoke, ready to explore. Discover songs, sing along, and keep your favorites close.

slides.title: Find your next song
slides.body: Browse Home and New, search for a song or artist, or tune in to live Radio. Try the demo search below.

slides.title: Listen and sing along
slides.body: Open Now Playing for playback and synchronized lyrics. Music can keep playing in the background, with controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center. Try these demo controls; they do not play audio.

steps.title: Try playback
steps.caption: Tap Play to reveal the lyrics demo.

steps.title: Follow the lyrics
steps.caption: Tap a line to highlight it in this example.

features.title: Sing along with synchronized lyrics
features.subtitle: Keep the next line in view

slides.title: Keep your favorites close
slides.body: Save favorite songs, organize playlists in Library, and pin the playlists you return to most. Download songs in the app to listen offline. Tap the demo heart to try saving a favorite.

slides.title: Music at a glance
slides.body: Add Twinskaraoke widgets from your Home Screen widget gallery. Now Playing shows playback controls and your queue, Live Radio shows what is on, and Recently Played can show recent, pinned, or favorite playlists.

slides.title: Take it to your wrist
slides.body: The watchOS companion brings music to Apple Watch, including playback, playlists, and downloads. Watch features are still in development—thank you for your patience as they improve.
